QuestInfo.name: Kenta's Adolescent Wolf Vitamins
QuestInfo.0: You've decided to prepare a bowl of Adolescent Wolf Vitamins for #t1902015#. Head to #b#m230000003##k to buy ingredients from #b#p2060005##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2060005# claims to have the vitamins necessary for Adolescent Wolves and agrees to sell them to you for 40 million mesos. *Sigh* It's a lot of money, but you should buy them for the sake of your wolf's health and well-being.\r\n\r\n#b40,000,000 mesos#k
QuestInfo.2: You paid 40 million mesos and bought some of Adolescent Wolf Vitamins from #p2060005#.

0.0: Hey, you're the one that bought the #t4032331# last time, right? How's the wolf pup growing? Come to think of it, it must be going through its adolescent stages right about now...\n#b#L0#(You ask about #t4032333#.)#l\n#k
0.1: Ahhh, are you talking about #t4032333#? Of course I have it with me. Wolves that are going through their adolescent stages require more nutrients than usual, so would you like to buy some more?

yes.0: As more nutrients are included in #t4032333# than #t4032331#, it also costs more... 40,000,000 mesos, or #b40 million mesos#k, to be exact.
yes.1: Way too expensive? I know, the market's been completely crazy these days and I can't even meet my payroll for #p2060006#. That's how rough it's been running #m230000003#... Otherwise, I would give you a discount.

no.0: I suppose you don't need any #t4032333# for your wolf? Your wolf might become malnourished then...

1.0: Are you going to purchase some #t4032333#? If you hand me your mesos, these vitamins will be yours.

yes.0: Wow, for you to spend that many mesos... you must really love your wolf. I guarantee that with a master like you, the wolf will weather the storm and emerge from its adolescence fully grown. Please take care of it.

item.0: I don't think you have #b40 million mesos on you#k. I do know that it's quite a lot of money for a wolf, but a companion like that cannot be measured in price.
